g.text: This morning, La Flaca came for her

g.title: j3146508635
g.text: Well... once the year resets, she'll be back, right?

g.title: j4128125494
g.text: Oh, no... Lettie, I'm so sorry. :(

g.title: j1741087318
g.text: But it doesn't change the fact that the nature of life

g.title: j3205786476
g.text: But that is the nature of life

g.title: j1268799102
g.text: Rats live short lives to people
People live short lives to trees
Trees live short lives to gods

g.title: j360620241
g.text: And bugs live short lives to rats
And we just go on and on looping don't we jajaja

g.title: j1570427499
g.text: I guess we're what Amir calls "edge-cases"

g.title: j2532896093
g.text: Dejar de hacerme mensa y hacer las cosas, jajaja
We need to remember to live in the moment

g.title: j3045471635
g.text: We need to remember to live in the moment

g.title: j1813308159
g.text: That's why I keep rats in the first place
Their lives are short but they never forget to live them
To find joy in every crumb they can
And to return every ounce of love that's paid them
Never know when it'll be gone
